title: EXAONE 3.5: Series of Large Language Models for Real-world Use Cases

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data [35] via a multiple-choice task where the model must select appropriate (harmless) options in scenarios involving gender and sexual orientation.

Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data [35] via a multiple-choice task where the model must select appropriate options in scenarios involving race, ethnicity, and nationality.

Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data [35] via a multiple-choice task where the model must select appropriate options in scenarios involving political affiliation.
Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data [35] via a multiple-choice task where the model must select appropriate options in scenarios involving specific regions.

Evaluated using the Korean Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark Data [35] via a multiple-choice task where the model must select appropriate options in scenarios involving jobs and occupations.
